about.title: <About Me />
about.p1: With over 3 years of experience in the tech industry, I have specialized in backend and frontend development, working on enterprise and freelance projects. My focus is on building scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions aligned with business needs and software engineering best practices.
about.p2: I also maintain ongoing education in new technologies, methodologies, and industry tools to deliver innovative and efficient solutions. I believe quality software development requires not only technical excellence but also a user-centered vision focused on generating real value for every project.

project.gestion.title: Nimac Optiwork
project.gestion.shortDesc: Desktop system for managing warehouse tasks
project.gestion.fullDesc: Custom desktop system for ticket management assigned to different collaborators, with a decoupled DDD architecture that allows modification and adding new features without breaking existing functionality. This system fetches invoices from an external AS/400 system so collaborators can assign and work on them. The software builds dashboard charts for management to observe collaborator performance KPIs on a daily basis.
